issue.title: Build Bible Tab with Verse List and Sequential Playback
issue.body: The Bible Tab is the listening surface on the drafting page. Oral Bible translation follows a listen-then-record workflow — translators absorb source passages before rendering them in the target language. The Bible Tab supports the full listening session: showing all verses in a chapter, tracking recording status at a glance, and allowing the translator to select any verse to work on. BCS field testers confirmed the concept immediately: "this is a good idea as a translator because you can listen to the whole chapter." This build targets verse-by-verse translation. Pericope view is a future phase. ## Functional Requirements ### Verse List - Display all verses in the chapter as a vertically scrollable list, one row per verse. - Each row shows: verse number on the left, full verse text (no expand/collapse needed; verses are short). A small `li:audio-waveform` icon appears below the verse number on the left side for every verse — green when a recording exists for that verse, gray when no recording exists yet. - On page entry, auto-scroll to the selected verse (see #47 for selected verse default logic). - Two distinct visual states apply to verse rows simultaneously: - **Selected verse:** filled left border accent — marks the verse the translator is working on; set only by explicit user action. - **Currently playing verse:** full row background highlight — tracks whichever verse the audio is currently playing through; updates as playback advances. - When both states apply to the same row, both indicators are shown together. - Tapping a verse sets it as the selected verse, scrubs the player to that verse's start, and does not auto-play. ### Sequential Playback - When source audio for a verse finishes playing, auto-advance: load the next verse's audio and begin playback automatically; update the currently playing highlight to the next row. - Sequential playback does not change the selected verse — it only moves the currently playing indicator. - Scroll the currently playing row into view if it is off-screen. - Stop when the last verse in the chapter finishes; do not loop. - If the user taps a verse during playback, that tap sets the selected verse and scrubs the player to that verse's start; auto-advance continues from that position. ### When there is no source audio - When source audio is not available, the player should be hidden.
